# Law.com features Evan Meyerson's article on law firm contingency


May 27, 2025


-
-
-
-


Law.com has published an article by[Evan Meyerson](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/evan-meyerson/) , where Meyerson highlights key takeaways from a roundtable with prominent US trial lawyers on the evolving use of contingency fee arrangements. The roundtable appeared in Burford's Quarterly and can be found online[here](https://www.burfordcapital.com/insights-news-events/burford-quarterly/2025-issue-2/law-firm-contingency-trends-roundtable/) .


[Read the full article here.](https://www.law.com/newyorklawjournal/2025/05/27/aligning-costs-and-outcomes-why-law-firms-are-shifting-to-contingency-and-alternative-fee-structures-/)
